title: Puto with Cheese: Steamed Coconut Rice Cakes Topped with Melting Cheddar
changes_from_base: a thin square of mild cheddar laid on each cake for the last 2-3 min of steaming
summary: Fluffy coconut rice cakes steamed in paper cases and finished with a square of cheddar that softens on top.
equipment: steamer (bamboo steamer over a wok, or a steamer insert)
16 paper cases in small metal or silicone moulds (about 60 ml)

ingredients.note: use a gluten-free one if needed

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
mild cheddar, cut into 16 thin squares

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: Combine the dry ingredients (rice flour, sugar, baking powder, yeast and salt) in the bowl. Pour in the coconut milk and warm water, then whisk for 2 min to a smooth batter that pours easily but still coats the whisk.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Cover with the tea towel and leave somewhere warm for 1 h until a few bubbles rise. The flour absorbs the liquid during this time, giving a softer crumb.

steps.title: Fill the cases
steps.text: Bring 5 cm of water to the boil under the steamer. Set the paper cases in their moulds and fill each three-quarters full.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Arrange in the steamer, wrap the lid in the tea towel and steam over steady high heat for 13-15 min, until risen and a skewer comes out clean.

steps.title: Add the cheese
steps.text: Lay a square of cheddar on each cake, cover again and steam for 2-3 min more. The cheese should soften and slump onto the top without running off; adding it late stops it sinking or turning oily.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cool for 5 min before lifting the cakes out of the moulds, then eat warm.

tips: Mild cheddar gives the classic sweet-salty contrast; a stronger one can overpower the cake.
A common mistake is adding the cheese at the start: it sinks and makes the tops dense.
Keep the water at a strong boil throughout steaming.
Cut the cheese thinly so it softens in the short time.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. Re-steam for 3-4 min until warm.
